summary.intent: Review a subagent's gate-measurement report for the caliper semantic checker (memory and determinism gates), decide what's next, then diagnose a failing CI check the user referred to as '#197' and prevent recurrence.
summary.outcome: Gate harness work was reported as PR #401 (memory gate PASS, determinism PASS only in nearest form). The '#197' reference matched no failing PR; it was assumed to be the failed Checker lane on #400, caused by stale checker-expectations.json (react/13 improved, react/34 regressed), and a worker was dispatched to fix it after user approval.

repo: tsrs `--api` mode has no checker-count flag (`--checkers` is compile-mode only), so ADR 0026's determinism gate cannot be measured as worded; RAYON_NUM_THREADS is the nearest proxy.
`OnDemand` recycles the checker process on a 64-program limit ('worn') or an RSS bound ('bloated'); at the shipped 768 MiB bound the program limit does all the recycling.

The `Test / Checker lane` is a required CI gate that compares rows against `checker-expectations.json`; it fails both on regressions and on 'better than expected' rows, so expectations must be updated in the same PR as checker-output changes.
Construct parity (`construct:parity`) covers tsrs-vs-Go parity; `just test-checker-lane` runs the lane locally.
Caliper repo is in orin-dx org; trail items (e.g. #197 'Names and values live in one place') are separate from PR numbers, so '#NNN' can be ambiguous between PRs and trail tasks.
Stacked-PR rule: wait for the base PR to merge before starting dependent slices (S5 waits on #400).
MuiPopoverRoot and MuiSliderMark are declined by the checker and keep structural answers; the cause was not investigated.

code.finding: Harness holding both gates, about 170 lines; run via `just gate-measure` (~17 min) against fixtures from scripts/gate_fixtures.mjs.
Must be updated for react/13 (now `spelled`) and react/34 (now less precise, emits bare `BoxProps`) in the same PR as the checker change.

workflow: Treat a subagent's hand-back as a report, not authority; verify branch, signatures and PR state yourself before relaying it, and state what was not re-measured.
Run the relevant CI lane locally and treat its exit code as part of the done check before pushing.
When a user reference like '#197' matches nothing, check across PRs, other repos and trail items, then ask rather than guess; state any assumption explicitly.
Don't hide regressions by recording them as gaps without a reason and a tracking item.

friction: User's '#197' was ambiguous: it matched a merged caliper PR, a nonexistent callisto PR and a trail task, costing several lookups before an assumption was made.
The earlier plan to update checker-expectations.json after #400 merged was wrong and led to a failing required check.
An earlier claim that slice 3 would turn react/13, 34 and 07 green was only true for react/13.
The harness came in over the requested 60 to 100 lines (about 170) because it holds both gates.
open_items: Fix or document react/34 (`BoxProps` bare regression) on #400; worker dispatched.
Fix remaining no-regression cases: react/29 comparator, react/34 rank, objects/23 internal name.
Reword ADR 0026's determinism bullet to 'deterministic across repeated runs, thread counts, restarts and query order' (user decision pending).
Review and merge #398, #400, #401; check whether #396 duplicates 0.10.0; delete old remote branches feat/construct-suite and perf/cycles-by-structure after #398 merges.
Start S5 (instantiation probe) after #400 merges, then S6 watch mode, S7 delete-resolver, S8 default flip plus @tsrs/<platform> optionalDependency.
Still-open default-flip gates: Linux CI run of the checker path and the no-regression gate.
Unverified: single process passing 768 MiB, real Storybook plus Node session, Linux/Windows, compile-mode --checkers, full `just test` suite.
Investigate why the checker declines MuiPopoverRoot and MuiSliderMark.
